title: Refit of manuscript 3.3 and 3.4 on public cohorts
why: 3.3 and 3.4 have no public substitute; the author chose to refit them on public cohorts rather than delete them.

cohorts.secondary: rice_PXD072089 (5,598 / 817 / 640), consistency only; a null there is not evidence of absence

inputs_verified: the rebuilt feature matrix reproduces the stored deployed external scores bit-exactly (max |diff| = 0.0, chem and full, both cohorts); ProtBERT embeddings align with zero rows missing

arms.label_permuted: NC1: control columns, y permuted across proteins, seed 20260921

verdict_statistic: top-100 distal (6-12) K/R log2 odds ratio, computed AFTERWARDS by scripts/run_self_audit_five_proteases.py on this machine; the server returns out-of-fold scores only

branches_3_3.P1_survives: control excludes zero AND both ablated arms exclude zero -> the manuscript's claim, replicated on public data
branches_3_3.P2_removed: control excludes zero AND at least one ablated arm crosses zero -> the claim does NOT generalise; narrow or withdraw. THIS CONTRADICTS THE MANUSCRIPT AND WE PUBLISH IT.
branches_3_3.P3_no_baseline: control crosses zero -> no bias to ablate here; 3.3 is deleted and the reason stated

branch_3_4.quantity: recovery ratio R = (AUC_T - 0.5)/(AUC_full - 0.5) on within-protein AUC, protein-clustered bootstrap; T: is exactly the 25-column detectability block
branch_3_4.Q1: interval lower bound > 0.50 -> detectability recovers most of the margin, replicated
branch_3_4.why_0.50: a meaning constant (majority of the margin), the same anchor Box 1 item 7 and the pKa MMD use; fixed before any value of R exists

controls.PC1: imported arms select 1,046 / 1,042 / 1,026 columns, else the round stops
controls.PC2: control arm within-protein AUC > 0.5 in the primary cohort
controls.PC3: verdict computed by the registered local instrument, never on the server
controls.NC1: label_permuted arm: within-protein AUC interval covers 0.5 AND top-100 enrichment interval crosses zero; otherwise nothing from this round is usable

declared_deviations: no structural features for external sequences; absolute performance not comparable across cohorts, only arm-to-arm within a cohort
no homology components; grouping, folds and bootstrap clusters are by protein, so intervals are narrower than house rule 2 would give
the label is NEG_A (observed in the reported enriched-site list); unobserved does not mean unmodified
no stored anchor to bridge to
compute: amax, CPU only, OMP_NUM_THREADS=16, own workdir. amax GPUs are NOT touched: GPU 0 was measured at 54% with 31 GB in use by another user when this was written.
cannot_decide: cannot restore 3.3 or 3.4 in their earlier form; they become statements about the architecture and feature set fitted to public data
says nothing about whether the model is a good persulfidation predictor
both cohorts are persulfidation; nothing transfers to other chemistries
a null result on rice is not evidence of absence
